rule: GM-eyes-only. A GM confirms agents and supply lines, never the Sovereign (the_satiated_sovereigns.md).

ladder.cutALine: a supply-line power broken (C1/C5), taken (C8), or its leader turned (leverage) costs the Sovereign that line
